messages:
sophia: Heads-up — starting the tenant_metadata schema swap tonight at 23:00 PST (quiet window 23:00–23:40). Pinning service @web-api to v2.14.1 during the window and enabling feature flag `tenant_meta_v2` only for canary. Please watch deploybot and smoke results. :eyes:

deploybot: canary queued for migration: mig-2026-tenant-meta at 6274839201. Estimated canary duration 10m, backfill ratecap=200/s. Will post progress and holdpoints.

ryan: ack. Quick ask — can we drop the full-table UPDATE in favor of batched CTAS + swap? avoids long locks. Example plan: `CREATE TABLE tenant_meta_new AS SELECT * FROM tenant_meta WHERE 1=0;` then incremental insert in chunks, then `ALTER TABLE tenant_meta RENAME TO tenant_meta_old;` `ALTER TABLE tenant_meta_new RENAME TO tenant_meta;`

natalie: +1 to CTAS. Also can we throttle backfill to 100/s for the first 5m to validate cache warming? put soft limit so deploybot doesn't spike.

marta: note: QA smoke found intermittent FK violation in staging on `user_profiles->tenant_meta` during a similar swap. Add FK validation step post-swap and a fallback plan to re-point reads to old table if validation fails.

zack: adding release-note blurb now: "tenant metadata schema swap (canary only) — requires web-api pinned v2.14.1; feature flag tenant_meta_v2 controls rollout." Will push to docs after final.

infra-bot: autoscaling alert: gpu-pool-4 has spare capacity, routing canary traffic to region-us-west-2. No rate limit blocks.

ryan: deploybot, please set backfill_ratecap=100 and enable canary traffic split 1%. Command: `deploybot start mig-2026 --canary --ratecap 100 --pin web-api=2.14.1`

deploybot: acknowledged. Executing: `start migration mig-2026` -> canary 1% -> ratecap 100/s -> pinned web-api=2.14.1. Expected next update in ~3m.

sophia: reminder — escape hatch: `deploybot abort mig-2026 --rollback canary` will roll back to old table and unpin web-api. Keep pager on standby.

(3m later) deploybot: canary step finished: partial backfill completed (approx 18k rows), no latency spike observed. Running FK validation check.

natalie: running smoke tests now. Starting user signup + tenant import.

natalie: smoke failed — signup 500s intermittently, stacktrace shows `constraint_violation: missing tenant_meta for user insert` on 3/10 attempts. Investigating.

marta: that aligns with the staging FK note. Could be a small race during the read routing. Suggest pausing rollout and reverting canary.

ryan: Agreed. We should abort canary, revert routing, keep the change window open for postmortem. Decision: roll back canary and re-evaluate CTAS/validation ordering.

sophia: I’m triggering abort now. `deploybot abort mig-2026 --rollback canary` (manual confirm) :rotating_light:

deploybot: Received abort request for mig-2026. Initiating rollback: re-pointing reads to tenant_meta_old, cancelling remaining backfill workers, unpinning web-api (reverting to previous runtime), and queuing a follow-up runbook. Rollback ETA ~4m.

infra-bot: smoke checks on rollback in progress. Observability: 5xx error rate trending down.

natalie: smoke passes after rollback. Signup flow clean. Thanks all.

zack: updating release notes to mark tonight's canary aborted and describe follow-up plan (CTAS + staged FK validation).

marta: follow-ups: 1) add FK validation step before flipping reads, 2) implement short-lived read-retry in web-api for tenant_meta lookups, 3) rehearse swap in staging with identical routing rules.

ryan: creating a postmortem ticket and scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll include the exact SQL snippets and the backfill throttling histogram.

sophia: great — closing thread for the night. Thanks for quick responses :heart:
